landing.hero_p: Automate support on WhatsApp, sync real calendars, track tasks, and issue recurring billing automatically. With the TrataTudo platform, your team reaches its full potential.
landing.services_section_p: Forget tool fragmentation. We have all crucial components prebuilt in a single high-performance console.
landing.service1_p: Cognitive agents trained with your company's knowledge to assist, qualify, and close sales on WhatsApp 24/7.
landing.service2_p: Conversation monitoring, filtered contact lists, operational history, and real-time enriched profiles.
landing.service3_p: Assign permissions, audit critical changes, and coordinate support teams in dedicated, secure channels.
landing.service4_p: Immediate synchronization of invoices, active Stripe subscriptions, and direct cash flow monitoring.
landing.service5_p: Automated client onboarding and friction-free smart scheduling, entirely free of duplicates.
landing.service6_p: Robust security segregation to manage multiple brands and instances with isolated databases.
landing.how_section_p: Our configuration flow has been optimized so that your company can start operating intelligently in a few minutes.
landing.how_step1_p: Connect your instance by scanning the dynamic QR Code generated instantly in our infrastructure panel.
landing.how_step2_p: Write business rules, fill in FAQs, and train your AI Master with corporate documents and prompts.
landing.how_step3_p: Your AI responds to clients, schedules bookings, qualifies the best leads, and generates automated invoices.
landing.cases_section_p: Discover some of the businesses that reduced administrative friction and amplified conversion.
landing.case1_p: "We configured the AI for automatic scheduling. In 30 days we had +400 new bookings and eliminated 100% of calendar gaps."
landing.case2_p: "We automated Tier 1 operational support by 95% and unified the entire billing flow via Stripe into a single central view."
landing.case3_p: "We qualify technical quotes 24/7 on WhatsApp. Our sales conversion rate grew by 35% immediately."
landing.plans_section_p: No hidden fees or complex commitments. Select the plan that best aligns with your business volume.
landing.faq_section_p: Need more clarification? If you have any other questions, contact our support directly.
landing.faq1_q: Is it easy to connect WhatsApp to TrataTudo?
landing.faq1_a: Yes, absolutely! The process is just like WhatsApp Web: scan the dynamic QR Code generated in our portal, and your channel is ready.
landing.faq2_q: Do I need coding skills to train the AI?
landing.faq2_a: No. Our AI Master is designed to be guided through natural language. Simply describe your business rules or upload manuals.
landing.faq3_a: Yes, legal compliance and data privacy are core pillars. All operational data, messages, and documents are stored securely in EU clusters.
landing.faq4_q: Can I cancel or change my plan anytime?
landing.faq4_a: Absolutely. There is no obligatory lock-in contract. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription directly from the billing panel each month.
